text:
Maya Park: Heads up — I opened three tiny docs PRs that need reviewers + merge timing before EOD. Can someone pick them up?
Kevin Liu: Which PRs? paste links please
Maya Park: PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/234 (sdk-snippets), https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/235 (migration-guide), https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/236 (redirect-fix). Deploy previews included.
Tara Singh: I can take the sdk-snippets and the redirect-fix. @Kevin — can you do the migration guide?
Kevin Liu: Yep, I can review the migration guide after standup. ETA ~11:30.
docs-ci-bot: [preview] build failed for PR #235 — linkcheck error:  /guides/migrate -> 404 (htmlproofer)
Sam Ortiz: I can try a tiny redirect patch for the migration guide. Looks like netlify redirect missing for /guides/migrate. I'll open a quick commit.
Maya Park: If Sam can push the redirect fix, can we aim to merge during the 12:00-13:00 merge window? keeps CI cycles predictable.
Julie Chen: quick note — rotation shows no one explicitly on SDK reviewer duty today. we usually do a "roster harvest" for small docs PRs — one person picks a batch. @Tara you're already volunteering?
Tara Singh: :thumbsup: I can harvest those. please assign me as reviewer on the GH PRs so i get notifications.
Kevin Liu: Assigned @Tara to #234 and #236. I'll queue #235 review and run the migration snippet locally.
docs-ci-bot: [preview] deploy succeeded for PR #234 — https://deploy-preview-234--redwood-docs.netlify.app/sdk-snippets
Sam Ortiz: pushed redirect fix in a tiny commit to #235. linkcheck passes locally: ```Checking 1 external links... 0 failures```
Maya Park: Great — merging after Kevin approves #235. Thanks all for the quick pickup.
Tara Singh: merging checklist: confirm preview link, sanity check code fences, add changelog entry if needed. I'll do a quick sweep before merge.
Kevin Liu: Approved #235, left a small nit on wording but not blocking.
Maya Park: Merged all three at 12:38. Closing thread. Thanks team :sparkles:
